principles: Additive Prisma models only — no destructive migrations
Ambiguous package membership remains UNRESOLVED (never invent links)
Customer packages stay tenant-isolated from public precedent packages
Operative document selection stays fail-closed until review/certification gates
KnowledgeSource / DocumentByteObject remain source of truth for bytes

models.name: FinancingPackage
fields: companyId String?  // null for public precedent; set for customer tenants
tenantKind CompanyTenantKind? // CUSTOMER vs EVALUATION isolation
instrumentFamily String  // CREDIT_FACILITY | INDENTURE_NOTES | ABL | HYBRID | UNKNOWN
status PackageIdentityStatus  // PROPOSED | REVIEW_REQUIRED | REVIEWER_VERIFIED | SUPERSEDED

models.name: FinancingPackageMember
fields: role PackageMemberRole  // BASE_AGREEMENT | AMENDMENT | RESTATEMENT | SUPPLEMENTAL | INTERCREDITOR | GUARANTEE | SECURITY | OTHER | UNRESOLVED
linkStatus PackageLinkStatus  // PROPOSED | EVIDENCED | UNRESOLVED | REJECTED
evidence Json?  // titles, accession, edge ids — not legal effectiveness
asOfPriority Int?  // counsel-ordered; null until reviewed

linkingRules: Same issuerCik required for public package membership proposals
Use existing KnowledgeRelationshipEdge as soft evidence only (DISCOVERED)
If multiple BASE_AGREEMENT candidates without restatement supersession → package.status=REVIEW_REQUIRED and operative unresolved
Customer companyId packages must not absorb PUBLIC_SEC_EDGAR members unless counsel explicitly attaches
migrationPlan: 2) Owner approval checkpoint before prisma migrate deploy
3) Backfill PROPOSED members from issuer+class heuristics with linkStatus=UNRESOLVED when ambiguous
4) Optional UI browse; Ask Headroom continues fail-closed on unresolved packages
